content: The apology continues: one of those he admonished was a great master of the age from whom he had humbly taken the khirqa-yi tabarruk before setting out; on returning he found that a group of the master's followers no longer observed the Sharīʿa. They met at a royal court and argued so hotly that they ended by railing at each other; some of the master's newer disciples then asked him for a short treatise, which he says it would have been wrong to refuse.
